dish.note: Puff pastry twists with sharp cheddar and paprika, the train snack on the way to Vermont.
dish.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Brush 2 thawed sheets of puff pastry with beaten egg and scatter one with 120g grated sharp cheddar and 1 tsp paprika. Lay the second sheet on top, press down, cut into 1.5cm strips and twist each one. Bake on lined trays for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and golden.
dish.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead and keep in an airtight tin; warm for 3 minutes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C and line two trays.
Brush the pastry with egg, scatter one sheet with cheddar and paprika and lay the other on top.
Cut into strips and twist each one onto the trays.
